reports.title: Robert Richards
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: bullying within HMP Wandsworth is not appropriately managed due to inadequate systems being in place, too few staff on duty, poor communication between teams, inadequate staff training, poor recognition of risk and the mixing of vulnerable prisoners with potential bullies
prisoners from other wings pass through the VP unit on a regular basis and thus increase the chance of bullying to the vulnerable prisoners.
training of medical staff in relation to Resuscitation is inadequate
system for ensuring restocking of medical supplies such as oxygen after they have been used needs to be reviewed

reports.title: Daniel Beckford: Prevention of Future Deaths Report

concerns.quote: The provision and content of first aid training. The evidence of witnesses revealed an absence of clarity in the first aid training to prison officers on the use of rescue breaths during resuscitation attempts, as per current advice from the Resuscitation Council UK
concerns.hazard: lack of clarity in first aid training on rescue breaths
